name: Midnight Mercenaries Multi-Gaming Community
summary: The Midnight Mercs Gaming Community aims for simple enjoyment of whatever game that's is being played, without all of the drama that's included in most clans. Our main goals are not only to provide a fun and enjoyable gaming atmosphere for guests / veterans alike, but to filter anything that could possibly ruin a gaming experience. If you're having troubles within the community it's guaranteed that if you tell an admin, it'll be solved as soon as possible. Interested in joining? name: RoaR Gaming Community
summary: RoaR.GG is a PC Gaming Community founded December, 2011. We believe games are more enjoyable in a organized environment but without all of the bull**** that's included in most gaming communities. RoaR.GG was initially founded as a Mount & Blade: Warband group but in 2017 we decided to make a big change and rebrand to an esports community. Due to the hard work and ambition of our staff and members through the transition we've been successful in growing our brand, providing teams, servers and events for our newly founded esports community. To many of us RoaR.GG is much more than a gaming community, it's a family. Looking to join? Add River, Kavcav or Maximus on steam.http://roaresports.com
